english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for entering a place without permission or welcome, often forcefully.
Use this when someone physically enters a place without permission, especially suddenly or forcibly.

examples.english: I saw a thief intrude into my home in the middle of the night.
examples.jyutping: siu2 tau1 bun3 je6 cong2 jap6 ngo5 uk1 kei2

examples.english: They dared to invade my home without my permission.
examples.traditional: 佢哋竟然未經我同意就闖入我屋企。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ging2 jin4 mei6 ging1 ngo5 tung4 ji3 zau6 cong2 jap6 ngo5 uk1 kei2
